basis: Versions below are read from the shipped migration files and the product contracts that tests and the native-runtime matrix verify. Nothing here promises an unverified upgrade or downgrade path.

runRequest.scope: POST /api/ai/v1/runs body contract (rag.chat / document.ingest / agent.run), idempotency-key replay and request-hash conflict semantics
runRequest.verifiedBy: R1 admission cases in scripts/ci/verify-native-runtime.sh; ruoyi-web node protocol tests

runEventStream.scope: GET /api/ai/v1/runs/{id}/events frames: id:<seq>, event:<type>, data with schemaVersion=1; afterSeq/Last-Event-ID replay cursor; terminal withheld behind sequence holes
runEventStream.verifiedBy: N3 cross-instance replay in scripts/ci/verify-native-runtime.sh; RunStreamClient/SseSyntax node tests

agentExecution.scope: agent.run execution version binding: a checkpoint whose executionVersion differs from p3-core-v1 fails with AGENT_CHECKPOINT_INCOMPATIBLE instead of being reused
agentExecution.verifiedBy: AgentRunExecutor checkpoint guard; FencedAgentStateStoreTest; P3 formal R4/R5 evidence

gatewayDelegation.scope: platform->AI delegated identity (RS256, X-P04-Service-Credential service credential), authorization check contract POST /internal/platform/v1/authorization/check
gatewayDelegation.verifiedBy: P04RunAcceptanceTest; AI/platform integration cases in the native matrix

verifiedUpgradePaths: fresh install from the shipped migration sets (platform 1..6, AI 1..12)
repeat migration is a no-op with validate passing
checksum drift, removed migrations and foreign schema owners are rejected
notVerified: database downgrade from a later schema to an earlier one - no claim of lossless rollback is made
cross-version rolling upgrades of a running cluster
compatibility.checkpointProtection: agent checkpoints carrying an executionVersion other than p3-core-v1 are refused, not silently migrated
